# MIME attachment emission supports URLs that do not implement the mail message URL interface

The 1927 emitter adds a plain URI GetSpec fallback. Current StartAttachment queries nsIMsgMessageUrl, uses originalSpec for news schemes and uri for other message URLs, and otherwise uses mURL.GetSpec. It then sends the resulting source string to nsIMailChannel.HandleAttachmentFromMIME. Preserve the generic-URI path when adding protocol channels; requiring every URL to implement the older mail interface would remove that fallback. This is static source inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: MIME URL interface fallback.
